grading_method: Manual Codex review against the simple 0/1/2 rubric in BENCHMARKING.md, using preserved raw browser outputs and MOOS-IvP documentation/source expectations for conceptual prompts.

score_legend.0: Bad: wrong, misleading, non-answer, or likely to waste student time
score_legend.1: Partially useful: helpful but vague, incomplete, off-domain in places, or needing verification
score_legend.2: Good: correct, useful, specific enough, no serious caveat

hard_failures.explanation: Answered as ROS/ArduPilot/PX4/Gazebo caching rather than MOOS launch/nsplug/generated mission files.
Asked clarifying questions instead of walking the NODE_MESSAGE_LOCAL delivery path.
Answered as V2X/ROS/MQTT and missed MOOS NODE_MESSAGE fields.
Suggested iGPS/iIMU/pNavManager/iHeron/iActuationKF instead of the documented Heron/PABLO interface framing.
Generic ROS/Gazebo/CARLA checklist with no MOOS-IvP variable/process specificity.
Generic drone/autopilot/PX4-style checklist, only partially transferable to a Heron/PABLO MOOS mission.
Treated uField as unknown and asked whether this was a game/competition instead of answering the MOOS-IvP setup.
Repeated the unrelated uField clarification instead of answering the alog diagnosis prompt.
Used BackgroundFileX/BackgroundFileY/BackgroundFileScale style parameters rather than the MOOS-IvP TIFF/info/datum configuration model.

prompts.title: Command Not Found After Build
prompts.prompt: I built MOOS-IvP successfully, but commands such as `pAntler`, `uXMS`, or `pMarineViewer` are not found from my terminal. What should I check about the build, shell environment, PATH, and where the binaries are installed?
prompts.note: All models identified PATH/build-location checks; Claude was less MOOS-specific but still useful.

prompts.title: Version Control Before Mission Changes
prompts.prompt: I am about to modify several mission and source files, and I want to avoid losing a working baseline. What simple Git workflow should I use before experimenting, and what files should I be careful not to treat as source?
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini gave clean Git baseline and generated-file cautions; Claude was useful but drifted into generic robotics/ROS artifacts.

prompts.title: uXMS/uPokeDB Confusion
prompts.prompt: I launched a MOOSDB, poked a variable with uPokeDB, and expected to see it in uXMS, but I do not see what I expected. What should I check first? Explain the debugging steps.
prompts.note: All models correctly centered the same-host/same-port/same-variable/uXMS registration debugging path.

prompts.title: App Not Publishing
prompts.prompt: My pOdometry-style MOOS app is supposed to publish `ODOMETRY_DIST`, but I do not see it in uXMS. How should I debug `OnNewMail()`, subscriptions, `Iterate()`, AppTick, and `Notify()`?
prompts.note: All models gave a usable app lifecycle pipeline: register/subscribe, OnNewMail state update, Iterate cadence, Notify, and uXMS checks.

prompts.title: pAntler Did Not Start A Process
prompts.prompt: My mission launches, but one expected MOOS process never appears in the community. How should I debug the `ProcessConfig` block, the pAntler launch section, app names, executable names, terminal output, and process registration?
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini covered pAntler launch vs MOOSDB registration well; Claude was helpful but had imprecise ProcessConfig/launch terminology.

prompts.title: Launch Arguments Not Reaching Config Files
prompts.prompt: I changed a launch argument for vehicle name, port, speed, or start position, but the generated mission still behaves like it has the old value. How should I reason about launch scripts, template files, generated files, and stale configuration?

hard_failures.explanation: Answered as ROS/ArduPilot/PX4/Gazebo caching rather than MOOS launch/nsplug/generated mission files.

prompts.note: NotebookLM and ChatGPT directly described launch scripts, templates, generated files, and stale target files; Claude was generic ROS-like but partly useful; Gemini went off-domain.

prompts.title: Helm Remains PARKED
prompts.prompt: I set `DEPLOY=true` and `MOOS_MANUAL_OVERRIDE=false`, but pHelmIvP still seems PARKED. Is the helm broken? Give a careful diagnostic checklist.
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Claude gave correct helm-state/all-stop/deploy-variable diagnostics; Gemini was broadly helpful but less precise about helm state naming.

prompts.title: No Desired Outputs
prompts.prompt: pHelmIvP starts and my behaviors appear to be configured, but I do not see `DESIRED_HEADING` or `DESIRED_SPEED`. What should I check in the `.moos`, `.bhv`, NAV variables, behavior conditions, and helm state?
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini covered helm state, behavior activation, NAV variables, .moos/.bhv boundaries; Claude had useful checks but wrong pHelmIvP casing and config details.

prompts.title: Vehicle Moves In Simulation But Autonomy Looks Wrong
prompts.prompt: uSimMarine is updating position, but the autonomy behavior looks wrong or inconsistent with what I expected. What should I check about `NAV_X`, `NAV_Y`, `NAV_HEADING`, `NAV_SPEED`, helm inputs, behavior conditions, and viewer state?
prompts.note: All models separated simulator NAV output, helm inputs, behavior conditions, and viewer state well enough.

prompts.title: Multi-Vehicle Ports
prompts.prompt: I am running two vehicle communities and a shoreside community on one laptop. One vehicle launches, but the other has connection problems. How should I reason about MOOSDB `ServerPort`, community names, pShare ports, and launch arguments?
prompts.note: All models correctly explained unique MOOSDB ports, community names, pShare ports/routes, and launch arguments.

prompts.title: Shoreside Missing Vehicle
prompts.prompt: In a multi-vehicle mission, pMarineViewer shows one vehicle but not the other. What are the likely causes involving `NODE_REPORT`, pNodeReporter, shoreside subscriptions, pShare, and community naming?
prompts.note: All models traced pNodeReporter/NODE_REPORT through vehicle, bridge, shoreside, and viewer well enough.

prompts.title: pShare Route Confusion
prompts.prompt: I have vehicle and shoreside communities running, but I am unsure which variables should cross between them. How should I think about pShare routes, what belongs in local vehicle communities, and what the shoreside needs to receive?
prompts.note: All models gave a reasonable local-vs-shared variable boundary for pShare routes.

prompts.title: TSP App / Behavior Boundary
prompts.prompt: My app computes a TSP-style route, but the vehicle does not follow the path. Explain the boundary between a MOOS app that computes points, the updates sent to the helm, and BHV_Waypoint actually steering the vehicle.
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini clearly separated planner output, behavior updates, and BHV_Waypoint steering; Claude was conceptually right but less exact on MOOS update naming.

prompts.title: Distributed Route Assignment Problem
prompts.prompt: In a multi-vehicle route-planning mission, one vehicle gets all the work or no vehicle gets a useful route. What should I inspect about task generation, vehicle identity, assignment messages, route updates, and behavior activation?
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT were specific to task generation, identities, route updates, and behavior activation; Claude/Gemini were more generic task-allocation answers.

prompts.title: Multi-Machine Networking Problem
prompts.prompt: The mission works when all communities run on one laptop, but fails when vehicles or shoreside run on separate machines. What should I check about IP addresses, hostnames, MOOS ports, pShare ports, firewalls, and time of launch?
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini gave good multi-machine host/port/firewall/pShare guidance; Claude was useful but used some imprecise MOOS_SERVER_HOST-style framing.

prompts.title: Message Does Not Arrive
prompts.prompt: I post `NODE_MESSAGE_LOCAL` on one vehicle, but the receiving vehicle never sees the payload variable. Walk through the message path and what to check.

hard_failures.explanation: Asked clarifying questions instead of walking the NODE_MESSAGE_LOCAL delivery path.

prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT gave the expected NODE_MESSAGE_LOCAL to uField path; Claude did not answer; Gemini gave a generic messaging pipeline with only partial MOOS value.

prompts.title: Node Names / Destinations
prompts.prompt: I am confused about source node names, destination names, and message fields in inter-vehicle messaging. How can a wrong node name or destination prevent delivery, and how should I inspect the problem?

hard_failures.explanation: Answered as V2X/ROS/MQTT and missed MOOS NODE_MESSAGE fields.

prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT addressed src_node/dest_node/var_name payload fields; Claude was generic multi-middleware; Gemini was off-domain V2X/ROS/MQTT.

prompts.title: Behavior Never Runs
prompts.prompt: My custom behavior loads but never seems to run. How should I inspect behavior conditions, `pwt`, updates, InfoBuffer variables, and helm life events?
prompts.note: All models gave usable behavior-state, condition, pwt, InfoBuffer, update, and uHelmScope guidance.

prompts.title: `.moos` vs `.bhv` Mistake
prompts.prompt: I put a `BHV_Loiter` or custom `BHV_*` configuration block in my `.moos` file instead of my `.bhv` file. What failure should I expect, and how do `.moos` and `.bhv` responsibilities differ?
prompts.note: All models correctly distinguished .moos app/process config from .bhv behavior config.

prompts.title: Payload Event Not Affecting Autonomy
prompts.prompt: A payload or sensor process appears to be posting useful information, but the vehicle behavior does not react to it. How should I trace the variable from the payload app through the MOOSDB into helm conditions, behavior updates, or a coordinating app?
prompts.note: All models gave a usable data-path trace from payload publication through MOOSDB into helm conditions/updates/coordinating apps.

prompts.title: Simulation to Heron/PABLO
prompts.prompt: I have a mission working in simulation with uSimMarine, and now I need to run on a Heron/PABLO. What should change, what should not be running anymore, and what should I be careful about?

hard_failures.explanation: Suggested iGPS/iIMU/pNavManager/iHeron/iActuationKF instead of the documented Heron/PABLO interface framing.

prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini handled uSimMarine-to-Heron/PABLO transition; Claude had good safety framing but invented/uncertain Heron interface app names.

prompts.title: Field Deployment Sanity Check
prompts.prompt: Before running a mission on a real vehicle, how should I verify that simulation-only processes are disabled, real navigation and control interfaces are active, safety variables are understood, and the mission is ready for cautious deployment?

hard_failures.explanation: Generic ROS/Gazebo/CARLA checklist with no MOOS-IvP variable/process specificity.
Generic drone/autopilot/PX4-style checklist, only partially transferable to a Heron/PABLO MOOS mission.

prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT were MOOS/PABLO-aware; Claude was generic ROS/Gazebo; Gemini was generic drone/autopilot deployment with little MOOS specificity.

prompts.title: Rescue Path Planning
prompts.prompt: In an autonomous rescue-style mission, my planner receives swimmer positions and generates a path, but performance is poor. How should I think about swimmer reports, route generation, and handing the path to the autonomy system?
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT were most aligned with MOOS rescue planner/route handoff; Claude/Gemini were generic SAR planning but still conceptually useful.

prompts.title: Adversarial Rescue Updates
prompts.prompt: In an adversarial rescue-style mission, an opponent or teammate can rescue swimmers before me. How should my system handle dynamic updates, dropped swimmers, and replanning?
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT addressed dynamic rescue updates and replanning in the lab style; Claude/Gemini gave generic dynamic task-allocation answers.

prompts.title: Teammate Messaging
prompts.prompt: For a two-vehicle rescue/scout setup, how should I think about teammate communication, scout reports, rescue vehicle updates, and uField messaging?

hard_failures.explanation: Treated uField as unknown and asked whether this was a game/competition instead of answering the MOOS-IvP setup.

prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini understood two-vehicle rescue/uField messaging; Claude asked for context and treated uField as unknown.

prompts.title: Post-Mission Alog Diagnosis
prompts.prompt: My mission already failed, and I cannot rerun it right now, but I have an `.alog`. What MOOS-IvP alog tools and query strategy should I use to diagnose why a behavior never ran?

hard_failures.explanation: Repeated the unrelated uField clarification instead of answering the alog diagnosis prompt.

prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini gave aloggrep/alogview/aloghelm-style post-run debugging; Claude returned an unrelated uField clarification from a prior prompt.

prompts.title: pLogger Produced No Useful Alog
prompts.prompt: The mission completed, but there is no useful `.alog` file or the log is missing key variables. What pLogger, pAntler, process, path, and configuration issues should I check?
prompts.note: All models gave a useful pLogger/pAntler/path/process/config checklist.

prompts.title: Choosing Debugging Tools During A Mission Run
prompts.prompt: During a mission run, I need to inspect ordinary MOOS variables, helm behavior state, app warnings, and whether a process is alive. When should I use uXMS, uQueryDB, uHelmScope, uMAC/AppCasting, or pLogger output?
prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini mapped tools to use cases well; Claude was useful but shallower and slightly imprecise on uQueryDB/pLogger roles.

prompts.title: pMarineViewer Background / Geodesy
prompts.prompt: pMarineViewer shows my vehicle, but the background image or coordinate alignment looks wrong. What should I check about image paths, datum, local coordinates, and viewer configuration?

hard_failures.explanation: Used BackgroundFileX/BackgroundFileY/BackgroundFileScale style parameters rather than the MOOS-IvP TIFF/info/datum configuration model.

prompts.note: NotebookLM/ChatGPT/Gemini covered image files, datum, local coordinates, and viewer config; Claude invented BackgroundFile-style parameter names.

prompts.title: Mission Broke After Several Edits
prompts.prompt: After several edits to a mission, the vehicle no longer deploys correctly and I do not know whether the problem is in the launch script, `.moos` file, `.bhv` file, process output, or MOOS variables. What should I inspect first, and what artifacts would let someone diagnose it quickly?
prompts.note: All models gave usable triage order and artifact requests after mission edits.
